class.name: VegetationPollen3D
class.brief_description: Pollen puffs from wind-pollinated plants brushed by bodies, simulated with NVIDIA Flow.
class.description: Grasses, sedges, rushes, reedmace, nettles and docks hold ripe pollen in dangling anthers, and a jolt shakes it out. This node watches the bodies in [member trample_group] (the movers that also press [GrassField3D]'s grass; a [code]trample_radius[/code] meta gives a body's radius, else 0.4 m). When one moves faster than [member min_speed] through plants of [member vegetation_field] that shed pollen, the plants it brushes puff pollen into a [code]PhysXFlow3D[/code] of its own: a pale cloud flung along the push, carried by the ground wind, curling in the body's wake and fading as it spreads. Species shed pollen when they carry the meta [code]pollen[/code] (the amount) and [code]plant_preset[/code]; the [PlantGenerator] [code]make_*[/code] sets add both (see [method PlantGenerator.get_pollen_amount]). They shed only in flower ([method PlantGenerator.get_pollen_release] for [member season], or [method WeatherMap3D.get_season] when [member season] is empty), not when wet, and a shaken plant refills over [member recharge_time]. Needs an engine built with [code]flow_sdk=[/code] and the Flow libraries beside it; without them this node shows a warning and does nothing.

method.description: How many placed plants can shed pollen.

method.name: reindex
method.description: Reads the field's placements again on the next step. It does so by itself when the field places a different number of plants.
